name: Love: A 4-Lettered-Mystery
source:
You play as Abel “Reed” Ashbourne, one hard-headed and short-fused fisherman (with a history of petty crimes) so emotionally constipated that it hurts. After the last few “unfortunate run-ins” with your childhood best friend and now mortal enemy (you tell yourself), Detective Jack Pizer, you find your buried feelings resurfacing again. 

Will you finally admit how you feel for him, or continue denying your desperate pining?

…And most importantly, will this turn out to be a fluffy love story or a nightmare scenario for you?

[From [url=https://foggybladed.itch.io/love-a-4-lettered-mystery]itch.io[/url]]
